Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing the gambling commission to increase fees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to authorizing the gambling commission to increasefees; and adding a new section to chapter 9.46 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9.46 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In accordance with RCW 43.135.055, the commission is authorized toincrease fees by up to five percent in fiscal year 2015.
